As for **cybersecurity in simple words**:

Imagine your computer, phone, or the AI chatbot you are building is like a **house**. 

* **Cybersecurity** is the set of locks, security cameras, walls, and alarm systems you use to protect that house from burglars (hackers, scammers, and computer viruses). 
* Just like you lock your front door so strangers can't walk in and steal your things, cybersecurity makes sure that bad guys can't break into your digital devices, steal your private information, or mess up the projects you are working on.

Since you are building an AI chatbot, cybersecurity is extra important because you want to make sure no one can hack your bot, steal your code, or trick it into doing bad things!
